test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In each of the following questions, there is a certain relationship between two given letter pairs on one side of (::) and pair is given on another side of (::) where another pair is to be found from the given alternatives, having the same relationship with this pair as the pairs of the given pair bear. Choose the best alternative.

DE : CE :: FG : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In the first pair, the first letter decreases by −1, while the second letter remains the same.

Here, DE : CE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6269dc49b58c7473c170ad96daf0033e507054e3bc169a191d7cbe79d17d6ab3.png] 

E → E (no change)

Similarly, FG : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bd3a2a1a66cff834d99a75773e9e0d6ca871da600fca5adf1d765ca78ff33d7.png] 

G → G (no change)

So, FG becomes **EG.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**
